services.name: Online Exhibitions
services.desc: This juried exhibition features quilts of all styles and sizes created by some of the State’s finest quilters. Presented by the Springville Museum of Art and the Utah Valley Quilt Guild with support from the Corn Wagon Quilt Company. Art Loops: Downtown connects Springville’s Main Street, Library, Civic Center, and Museum of Art through more than 100 public artworks, installations, and community-created projects that weave art into everyday life throughout Downtown Springville. This exhibition offers a behind-the-scenes look at several artworks featured in the Art Loops, showcasing the sketches and creative processes that brought them from idea to reality. services.name: Schedule A Tour
services.desc: Community and church groups can experience customized tours designed to engage your group’s interests. Activity-based tours with hands-on learning opportunities are also available for youth groups. School tours serve public, private, and homeschool groups of all grade levels. Each scheduled school receives a pre-visit packet containing suggested activities and images to help students and teachers prepare for their Museum visit. Join us for a fun and engaging 15-minute introduction to our Museum on the second Wednesday of the month at 7pm!
